series.low-poly.seoTitle: Low Poly 3D Asset Packs for Unity, Godot & Unreal
series.low-poly.blurb: Modular low poly cities, traffic, villages, schools, SWAT teams and more, all on one palette texture, one scale and one 8 m grid.
series.low-poly.long: The core HanX Assets series: stylized low poly 3D models built to snap together. Every pack shares a single 1024×1024 palette texture and one material, so an entire city scene batches into a single draw call. Made for mobile games, prototypes, city builders, driving games, simulators and tactical shooters.

series.3d-pixel.blurb: Crunchy pixel textures on clean 3D shapes: dungeons, medieval towns, farms, interiors, RPG items and a SWAT squad.
series.3d-pixel.long: 3D pixel art (also called HD-2D or pixel-textured low poly) gives you the charm of retro sprites with real 3D lighting and cameras. Each HanX 3D Pixel pack uses point-filtered pixel textures at one texel density, so dungeons, towns and props from different packs sit together.

engine.unity.title: Low Poly 3D Assets for Unity
engine.unity.how: Drag the FBX or GLB files into your Assets folder, assign the shared palette material once and drop prefabs into your scene. Works with URP, HDRP and the Built-in pipeline.
engine.godot.title: Low Poly 3D Assets for Godot 4
engine.godot.how: Godot 4 imports GLB natively: copy the files into res://, double-click to create inherited scenes and you are done. One material keeps mobile and web exports fast.
engine.unreal.title: Low Poly 3D Assets for Unreal Engine 5
engine.unreal.how: Import the FBX files with Combine Meshes off, create one material instance from the palette texture and reuse it for every mesh. Nanite is not needed, the models are already tiny.
engine.blender.title: Low Poly 3D Models for Blender
engine.blender.how: Open the included .blend file: every model is already marked as an Asset, so the whole pack shows up in Blender’s Asset Browser, ready to drag into your scenes and renders.

faq.title: FAQ: Licensing, Engines & Checkout
faq.description: Answers about HanX Assets: commercial license, Unity, Godot and Unreal support, file formats, mobile performance, bundles and the itch.io checkout.
faq.lead: Still stuck? Ask in the comments of any pack on itch.io or on X.
faq.1.q: Can I use HanX Assets in commercial games?
faq.1.a: Yes. Every pack comes with a royalty-free license for unlimited personal and commercial projects: games, apps, videos, client work and game jams. No attribution is required. The only thing you can’t do is resell or redistribute the raw asset files themselves.
faq.2.a: All packs work in Unity, Godot 4, Unreal Engine 5, Blender, three.js (WebGL) and any engine that reads glTF (GLB), FBX or OBJ. A native Blender .blend file is included, with every model already marked as an Asset for the Asset Browser.
faq.3.q: Are the assets optimized for mobile and web games?
faq.3.a: Yes. The models are low poly (typically a few hundred to about 2,000 triangles) and every pack shares one material and one small palette texture, so whole scenes can batch into a single draw call. That suits mobile, WebGL, VR and Nintendo Switch-class hardware.
faq.4.q: Can I mix models from different packs?
faq.4.a: Yes, that is the whole idea. The low poly packs share one palette, real-world scale and an 8 m grid, so City, Traffic, Village, School, SWAT and the Halloween and Christmas editions snap together. The 3D pixel packs share one pixel density, so they mix the same way.
faq.5.q: How do I buy and download the packs?
faq.5.a: Click any Buy button on GameAssets.tr and the secure itch.io checkout opens. Pay with card or PayPal; the download link is available at once and stays in your itch.io library, including new files the pack receives.
faq.6.a: Yes. We currently offer {bundles} bundles that include several packs for a fraction of the single prices. The Bundles page lists the current deals and their end dates.
faq.7.q: How much do the asset packs cost?
faq.7.a: Packs start at {min}. The catalog has {packs} packs with more than {models} game-ready models in total.
faq.8.q: Was generative AI used to make these assets?
faq.8.a: No. Every model is hand-made by HanX Games, and the packs are tagged “No generative AI was used” on itch.io.
faq.9.q: Do you take requests or custom work?
faq.9.a: We love requests. Leave a comment on any pack’s itch.io page or reach us on X (@Hanxgames_) and tell us what your game needs; popular requests become new packs.
lic.title: Asset License: Royalty-Free Commercial Use
lic.description: The HanX Assets license in plain words: use the low poly and 3D pixel models in unlimited commercial games, apps and videos. No royalties, no attribution required.
lic.h1: Use it. Ship it. Sell your game.
lic.lead: Every pack carries a royalty-free commercial license. The LICENSE.txt in each download is the full, binding text; this is the short version.
lic.canA: Use the assets in unlimited personal and commercial projects: games, apps, videos, client work, game jams and prototypes. Modify, recolour and combine them freely, and ship them inside packaged games on any store. Credit is welcome, never required.
lic.cantA: Resell or redistribute the raw asset files, alone or inside another asset pack, upload them to model libraries or marketplaces, or claim the original models as your own artwork.

about.title: About HanX Games, the Studio Behind HanX Assets
about.description: HanX Games is an indie game studio from Türkiye making hand-made low poly and 3D pixel asset packs: {packs} packs and {models}+ models for Unity, Godot and Unreal.
about.h1: The assets we wished we had.
about.lead: HanX Games is an independent game studio from Türkiye.
about.p1: While building our own games we kept hitting the same wall: asset packs that did not match each other, used dozens of materials and slowed mobile builds to a crawl.
about.p2: So we made HanX Assets: {packs} hand-made packs and {models}+ models. The low poly packs share one palette texture, one real-world scale and one 8 m grid, and the 3D pixel packs hold one pixel density. Cities, traffic, villages, schools, building sites, a full SWAT team, pixel dungeons and seasonal Halloween and Christmas editions fit together into one world.
about.p3: Every model is made by hand, with no generative AI, clean topology, clean names and a README listing triangle counts and sizes.
about.requestsA: Comment on any pack’s itch.io page.
